messages:
maria: Heads-up — ACME wants to onboard a small / fast variant 'llama-lite-6b' for internal search autocompletion. They flagged latency (<40ms p50) and cost sensitivity. Asking if we can prioritize smoke onboarding this week.
josh: tagging eng-ml triage. quick question: do we have a compatible export from their vendor (HF or ONNX?), or is it raw PyTorch weights?
anya: they sent a 4-bit quantized PyTorch checkpoint (custom q4) and a small validation set. said they only need generation and embeddings.
maria: yup, vendor file attached in the ticket. ACME is okay with conservative fallback to our hosted small model if quant fails.
rahul: quick compatibility checklist I need: 1) tokenizer mapping, 2) KV cache layout, 3) attention kv format. if tokenizer != our vocab we need remap.
josh: can someone run a smoke load on a dev node? recommend q4_0 path + float16 fallback. minimal smoke steps:
```
# smoke generation
curl -s -X POST https://dev-api.redwood/models/llama-lite-6b/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"complete: hello","max_tokens":32}'
```
anya: i'll validate tokenizer and vocab mapping today. if vocab mismatch >2% we need to run token remap and regen embedding table.
maria: priority: customer asked for P0 demo next Wed. not full SLA. just a safe smoke and perf number. can we commit to that timeline?
kevin: prodops: need to know deployment mode. hosted ok for demo? also any data residency needs? ACME said EU-only for logs.
maria: demo can be hosted but EU region only. no customer secrets in logs; we should enable logging redact. reach out to security for KMS config.
rahul: i'll start a quant regression run to compare q4_0 vs float16 baseline on their val set. if quality drop >3% EM or top-1 we'll fallback.
josh: if rahul posts the perf numbers i can set up a canary route in staging and throttle to 10rps. deploy-bot pls schedule a canary window.
deploy-bot: canary window created: staging/llama-lite-6b - 2h slot tomorrow 10:00-12:00 UTC. @josh @rahul
anya: found a minor tokenizer mapping mismatch — 0.8% of tokens map differently. I can patch with a remap script but embeddings will shift; will run a short eval.
maria: thanks. keep updates short. if remap adds >1 day we fallback to hosted small model for demo and continue onboarding in parallel. :thumbsup:
